title: 15 Settings UI fixes
lede: Reservation Rules and Checkout Policies are easier to save, reset and recover. Appearance choices are clearer for keyboard and screen-reader users.

sections.heading: Matched before and after
sections.note: Actual page components with isolated response fixtures. Both captures use the same viewport, data, appearance, locale, clock and scroll. The original dirty source snapshots and bundled styles are retained. This is component proof, not authenticated application proof.

notes: No live settings were changed. No commit, push or deployment. Authenticated application verification remains open because this run used isolated component fixtures without a signed-in application session.
Browser unload protection covers reload and tab/window close; client-side route transitions are not covered.

Mobile captures and inline save-error captures are after-only supplemental evidence in this directory. Source hashes cover retained page snapshots plus the exact component bundle and styles used for capture.
